thread:
kevin: Heads up - new seed account 123456789012 needs GPU & networking ceilings in eu-west-12. We plan to deploy a small pilot cluster for retail workload. Need quota increase ASAP.

sam: Which instance types and counts?

kevin: Planning initial pool: p5 instances x6 (inference-heavy), g5.xlarge x8 for baseline tests, p4d.24xlarge x1 for perf evals. Prefer dedicated quotas for p5 and p4d.

maria: Also check ENI / IPv4 limits in the VPC. These regions often need ENI ceilings raised before we can attach many GPUs. What subnet sizing are you using?

kevin: /22 primary + /24 spare for burst (we might need to bump to /21 if AWS restricts ENI mapping). Asking for ENI quota bump from default 100 -> 400 and IPv4 addresses per subnet increase.

laura: Cost note: p5s will be expensive. Can we stage with fewer p5s and use g5s as fallback while AWS approves? Would help control burn.

kevin: Good call. Proposed ramp: week1 g5 x8, p5 x2; week2 scale to p5 x6 if quotas approved. Also request spot fallback for non-prod.

sam: I'll open the AWS support ticket and loop in our account rep. Drafting request now - will include exact resource names, desired limits, and justification.

sam: (bot) creating case...

aws-support-bot: CASE-20250414-9843 opened with AWS Support. Initial classification: service-quotas/ec2-accelerator. Assigned rep: anna.repsmith@aws. Expect response within 48h.

kevin: Thanks. Paste of the request body I'm sending to AWS: ```Account: 123456789012
Region: eu-west-12
Resources: p5.24xlarge (6), p4d.24xlarge (1), g5.xlarge (8)
Requested increases: On-Demand Accelerator Count -> +20 for p5 family, +5 for p4d family; ENIs per Region -> 400; ENI attachments per instance -> 8; Elastic IP count -> 50; Secondary IPv4 CIDR -> request /21 allocation
Justification: Production-critical inference tests for Redwood Inference pilot customers. Staging traffic will start within 7 days.
```

maria: Make sure you include VPC id and AZ list, and mention the subnet CIDR constraints so support can adjust quotas vs IP pool. Also add a fallback plan to use g5/g4dn family if p5 capacity delayed.

sam: Added VPC and AZs. Also attached perf run schedule and cost acceptance sheet. Noted fallback. Submitted update to CASE-20250414-9843.

deploy-bot: aws:quota-change-request: CASE-20250414-9843 -> status: Awaiting-Quota-Review :hourglass:

laura: Parallel ask for increase in ENI-related soft limits in our org's service-quotas console would speed this. Can infra run the service-quotas request too?

maria: I'll do the console submit now. Steps: 1) open service-quotas console 2) select EC2 -> "Running On-Demand Accelerator (G5/P5/P4)" 3) request new limit values 4) attach justification + link to CASE-20250414-9843.

maria: Done. Service-Quotas request ID SQ-20250414-22 linked to support case.

kevin: ETA from AWS rep?

aws-support-bot: CASE-20250414-9843 update: Initial review complete. EC2 capacity check in eu-west-12 shows limited p5 spare capacity this week; quota increases approved pending capacity validation. Rep suggests scheduled provisioning on 2025-04-18.

kevin: Ok, schedule looks good. Sam, coordinate the provisioning with infra runbook (confirm ENI mapping, subnet sizes, bootstrap scripts).

sam: On it. Will run pre-provision checklist: 
- confirm subnet /21 availability
- verify ENI limits applied to account
- update autoscaler config for instance types
- validate boot AMI with kernel and nvidia drivers
- smoke test with small batch workload

laura: Reminder: add tagging policy and cost-center tags on instances to attribute pilot costs.

maria: Also adding an alert to console for "accelerator shortage" so we can failover to g5 automatically if AZ capacity drops.

kevin: Thanks all. I'll update the customer pilot timeline after provisioning is locked in. :thumbsup:

sam: Will post progress updates in this thread and ping when quotas are in effect.

maria: Closing the coordination loop: if AWS confirms scheduled provisioning, we'll reserve ENIs and ramp as discussed.

kevin: Great. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
